functional_comparison_contract.common_operation: exact signed32 accumulator multiplied by an admitted UQ0.24 checkpoint threshold, producing signed56
functional_comparison_contract.m35_specialization: ten immutable H67-ep35 descriptor IDs and eight outputs per accepted packet
functional_comparison_contract.m33_generality: runtime UQ0.24 threshold word and four outputs per accepted packet
comparison_metrics: setup and hold WNS with explicit corners
